prompt: ___ he refused the prize surprised us. 横线处填哪一个？
explanation: 主语从句不缺成分、表示一件事，用 That。

prompt: 哪一句用 it 作形式主语？

choices.text: That is clear she devoted her life
Clear that she devoted is it
It is clear that she devoted her life to research

explanation: It is clear that 后面才是真正的主语从句。
verify: "It is clear that she devoted her life to research"

prompt: ___ he discovered is still unknown. 从句缺少发现的内容，横线处填哪一个？
explanation: 从句缺少宾语时用 What，不能用 That。

prompt: 哪一句是正确的？

choices.text: That the theory works has been proved
The theory works has been proved
That the theory works have been proved
Which the theory works has been proved

explanation: That 从句作主语时，谓语用单数 has。
verify: "That the theory works has been proved"

prompt: ___ she will accept the honour is unknown. 横线处填哪一个？
explanation: 主语从句放在句首表示“是否”时用 Whether，不用 If。

prompt: 哪一句语序正确？

choices.text: Whether is he a genius is not important
If he is a genius is not important
Whether he is a genius is not important

explanation: whether 从句用陈述语序 he is。
verify: "Whether he is a genius is not important"

prompt: It is uncertain ___ they discovered the cause. 横线处填哪一个？
explanation: 不确定“是否”用 whether。

prompt: 哪一句不能放在句首？

choices.text: Whether she will come is unknown
If she will come is unknown
That she will come is certain
What she will say is unknown

explanation: If 不能引导放在句首的主语从句。

prompt: 想说她把一生献给了研究，哪一句合适？

choices.text: She not devoted her life to research
She devoted her life to reseerch
She devoted her life to research

explanation: devoted her life to 用来概括事业。

prompt: 想说她是否得奖还不清楚，哪一句合适？

choices.text: Whether she will get the honour is unknown
If she will get the honour is unknown
Whether will she get the honour is unknown

explanation: 句首用 Whether，语序是 she will get。
verify: "Whether she will get the honour is unknown"

prompt: 想先给结论再说事实，哪一句合适？

choices.text: It is clear his discovery changed that
It is clear that his discovery changed medicine

explanation: It is clear that 先给评价。
verify: "It is clear that his discovery changed medicine"

prompt: 想按步骤介绍人物，哪一句适合作为第二步？

choices.text: Next, he was published the theory

explanation: Next 用来连接步骤。

prompt: 要点：多年研究、发现挽救病人、不是每个学生都知道。哪一句三个要点都有？

explanation: 简介可以先说明 This paragraph introduces。

prompt: 哪一句的主语从句用了 Whether？

choices.text: Whether the story is widely known matters
If the story is widely known matters
Whether is the story known matters
